**M03** (supported)

> The postseason model does not use winning percentage as an input because it focuses on **net rating** and **top-player quality** as the two key factors that predict playoff success. These metrics are known before the playoffs begin and are things the lab can analyze about a team's roster before the season starts.
>
> **Net rating** reflects how effectively a team scores and defends, which is a strong indicator of overall team performance. **Top-player quality** measures the impact of the three best players on the team, as determined by the value model. These players are crucial for playoff success, and their combined impact is a reliable predictor of how a team will perform in the postseason.
>
> Winning percentage, while useful, is a result of the team's performance throughout the season and does not provide the same level of insight into the team's potential for playoff success. The model was tested with alternative inputs, including net rating alone or using the best player instead of the top three, but these alternatives did not perform as well as the combination of net rating and top-player quality.
